labs.name: Alibaba
labs.description: The technology company whose Qwen team develops the Qwen models, served by Alibaba Cloud through Model Studio.

labs.name: Amazon
labs.description: The technology company that develops the Amazon Nova models and builds Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Kiro, and the Strands Agents SDK.

labs.name: Anthropic
labs.description: The AI company that develops the Claude models and builds the Claude apps, Claude Code, and the Anthropic API on them.

labs.name: Cohere
labs.description: The AI company that develops the Command models for enterprise use and, through its research lab Cohere Labs, the Aya and North releases.

labs.name: DeepSeek
labs.description: The AI company that develops the DeepSeek V, R, and OCR models and runs the DeepSeek app and API on them.

labs.name: Google
labs.description: The technology company whose Google DeepMind unit develops the Gemini and Gemma models that Google serves through the Gemini API, Vertex AI, and the Gemini apps.

labs.name: Meta
labs.description: The technology company that develops the Llama and Muse models and builds Meta AI, Muse Code, and the Meta Model API on them.

labs.name: Microsoft
labs.description: The technology company that develops the MAI and Phi models and builds the Copilot assistants, Microsoft Foundry, and several agent frameworks.

labs.name: MiniMax
labs.description: The AI company that develops the MiniMax M-series language models, alongside speech, music, and video models, and offers them through the MiniMax Open Platform.

labs.name: Mistral AI
labs.description: The AI company that develops the Mistral, Ministral, Magistral, Devstral, and Voxtral models and runs Mistral AI Studio and the Mistral Vibe assistant on them.

labs.name: Moonshot AI
labs.description: The AI company that develops the Kimi models and offers them through the Moonshot AI Open Platform.

labs.name: NVIDIA
labs.description: The accelerated-computing company that develops the Nemotron models, serves models through the NVIDIA API Catalog, and maintains the TensorRT LLM runtime.

labs.name: OpenAI
labs.description: The AI company that develops the GPT, o-series, and gpt-oss models and builds ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API on them.

labs.name: SpaceXAI (xAI)
labs.description: The AI company, formerly xAI, that develops the Grok models and builds Grok, Grok Bot, and the xAI API on them.

labs.name: Z.ai
labs.description: The AI company, known in China as Zhipu, that develops the GLM models and builds the Z.ai assistant, ZCode, and the Z.ai and BigModel APIs on them.
